verdict.rationale: Morph's docs explicitly say to point any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1 with one API key. Existing OpenAI code needs only a new model string, and dedicated endpoints also connect via an OpenAI client. A community user independently confirmed the OpenAI-compatible endpoint worked with their existing CLI tool. Missing for 10: no published OpenAPI spec or detailed compatibility matrix showing which OpenAI SDK parameters and endpoints beyond chat completions are supported.
